facts.fact: TechAfrica News says the 2Africa cable was declared complete and activated in late 2025, with MTN GlobalConnect (Bayobab) leading the landing in Nigeria.

TechAfrica News says 2Africa is built on an open-access principle, with landing station operators giving equitable wholesale access to its capacity; the statement is cable-wide and not Nigeria-specific.

systems.owner: Meta-led consortium; MTN GlobalConnect (Bayobab) led Nigeria landing
